name: toast
title: Toast
description: Notifications on Base UI's Toast: a region in a corner of the window (or in the page flow) of toasts with a title, a description, a tone (info, success, warning, danger), an optional action and a close button; sticky toasts and high-priority announcements; no network.

manifest.name: toast
manifest.title: Toast
manifest.description: Notifications on Base UI's Toast: a region in a corner of the window (or in the page flow) of toasts with a title, a description, a tone (info, success, warning, danger), an optional action and a close button; sticky toasts and high-priority announcements; no network.
manifest.usage: Use Toast for short news about something the user did or that happened in the background: an export finished, a connection dropped, access is about to expire. Put one Toast near the root of the app with the app inside it, then call useToast().add({ title, description, type, timeout, priority, actionProps: { children, onClick } }) from any component, or pass a manager from createToastManager() as toastManager to add toasts from outside React. timeout: 0 keeps a toast until dismissed (use it for anything with an action the user must not miss); priority: "high" announces it at once. Errors that block a task belong on the page (an Alert); a decision belongs in an AlertDialog.

props.name: placement
props.description: Where the region sits: fixed in a corner at z.toast, or static in the page flow (previews, docs, tests).

props.name: limit
props.description: Toasts shown at once; the older ones wait.

props.name: timeout
props.description: Default ms before a toast closes; 0 keeps toasts until dismissed.

props.name: toastManager
props.description: A manager from createToastManager, to add toasts from outside React.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: The accessible name of each close button.

props.name: children
props.description: The app; components inside call useToast.

props.name: add(options)
props.type: { title, description, type, timeout, priority, actionProps, onClose } => id
props.description: useToast() / manager: adds a toast; also update(id, options), close(id) and promise(promise, { loading, success, error }).

slots.name: region
slots.description: role="region" named Notifications, aria-live="polite", size.panel.sm wide; with the theme and density where Toast is placed; data-slot="toast", data-placement.

slots.name: actions
slots.description: The action Button and the close IconButton; data-slot="toast-actions".

parts.name: ToastItem
parts.description: One toast: role="dialog" ("alertdialog" for high priority), color.bg.overlay with elevation.overlay and a coloured inner-edge border by tone; Toast renders one per toast.

states.name: tone
states.description: type sets the inner-edge border: color.status.info, success, warning or danger border.

states.name: entering
states.description: A new toast grows from 95 % and fades in over motion.duration.base; reduced motion turns it off.

states.name: leaving
states.description: A closing toast fades out with motion.easing.exit.

states.name: limited
states.description: Over the limit: hidden until a newer toast closes.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: A focused toast shows the focus ring.

accessibility: The region is role="region" named "Notifications" with aria-live="polite": new toasts are read without moving focus. A toast with priority "high" is also announced at once through a role="alert" copy.
Each toast is a non-modal dialog labelled by its title and described by its description; its action is a Button and its close button an IconButton with an accessible name.
F6 moves focus into the region (Base UI's hotkey) and Tab moves between toasts and their buttons; Escape closes the focused toast. Hovering or focusing the region pauses the timers.
Anything the user must act on (an expiry warning with Renew) uses timeout 0 so it does not vanish before it can be reached.
The tone is a border colour and the title says the same in words, so meaning does not rest on colour.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce turns the scale and fade transitions off.
